description: This file defines the DeployedRelationships class, which manages the deployment and handling of module relationships within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for loading, saving, building, and deleting relationships, as well as integrating with ModuleInstaller for relationship installation and cache clearing.

classes.name: DeployedRelationships
classes.description: Manages deployed module relationships, including loading, saving, building, and deleting relationships, as well as handling UI layout modifications and integration with the ModuleInstaller for deployment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DeployedRelationships object for a specific module and loads its relationships.

methods.name: findRelatableModules
methods.description: Returns modules that are relatable to the current module, including activities if specified.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads deployed relationships for the module, enriching definitions with metadata and subpanel info.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current set of relationships to a custom working directory.

methods.name: _updateRelationshipDefinition
methods.description: Placeholder for updating relationship definitions from older to newer formats; returns the definition unchanged here.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a relationship from deployment, including UI layout fields and cache clearance, and uninstalls the relationship.

methods.name: getAllRelationships
methods.description: Returns all relevant relationships, combining in-memory and deployed ones.

methods.name: identifySubpanel
methods.description: Finds the subpanel name in the parent module for a given related module.

methods.name: identifyRelateField
methods.description: Finds the relate field name in a module that sources from a specified related module.

methods.name: enforceRelationshipOnly
methods.description: Placeholder for enforcing 'relationship only' constraints on relationships to avoid UI conflicts.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and installs all relationships for the module, integrating with ModuleInstaller and clearing caches.

methods.name: saveFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Adds relationship fields to layouts like DetailView and EditView for relevant modules.

methods.name: removeFieldsFromDeployedLayout
methods.description: Removes relationship-related fields from module layouts after relationship deletion.
